headlines.title: Are You Looking for a High-Growth Dividend Stock?
headlines.summary: Dividends are one of the best benefits to being a shareholder, but finding a great dividend stock is no easy task. Does Exelon (EXC) have what it takes? Let's find out.

headlines.title: The Bull Case For Exelon (EXC) Could Change Following A Data Center‑Driven Grid Rethink - Learn Why
headlines.summary: Recently, Exelon’s utility ComEd worked with Richardson Electronics and Illinois leaders to expand local manufacturing of battery energy storage systems and support a 5‑MWh onsite demonstration project under the state’s REV Illinois program, while the Executive Leadership Council recognized Exelon with its 2026 Corporate Award for its long-term leadership development and community efforts.

headlines.title: Exelon (EXC) Battery Storage Push Puts Fair Value Back In Focus
headlines.summary: Exelon (EXC) is back in focus after Commonwealth Edison, its Illinois utility, partnered with Richardson Electronics on an expanded push into locally produced battery energy storage systems and a 5-MWh demonstration project. Exelon’s recent battery storage push comes at a time when the stock is trying to rebuild momentum, with a 7 day share price return of 2.68% and a 90 day share price decline of 8.95%, compared with a 5 year total shareholder return of 39.36%.

headlines.title: What Does Exelon (EXC) Mean For Illinois’ Largest Commercial Battery Project?
headlines.summary: Exelon (NasdaqGS:EXC) subsidiary ComEd and Richardson Electronics announced a major project to deploy Illinois’ largest commercial battery energy storage system. The expanded installation is designed to support grid reliability in Illinois and help accommodate more renewable generation on the network. The project is linked to Illinois clean energy support programs that encourage commercial adoption of advanced storage technologies.

headlines.title: The Executive Leadership Council to Honor Exelon with 2026 Corporate Award for Investment in Leadership and the Next Generation of Talent
headlines.summary: The Executive Leadership Council (ELC) today announced that Exelon will receive the 2026 ELC Corporate Award at The ELC Recognition Gala on Friday, October 30, 2026, at the Gaylord National Resort & Convention Center in National Harbor, Maryland.

description: Exelon Corporation, a utility services holding company, engages in the energy distribution and transmission businesses in the United States. The company is involved in the purchase and regulated retail sale of electricity and natural gas; transmission and distribution of electricity; and distribution of natural gas to retail customers. It serves residential, commercial, industrial, and public authorities and electric railroads customers. Exelon Corporation was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.
